Name: KithMyTrainer

[b][size=4]Controls[/size][/b]
[b]Numpad 9[/b] — Open the menu
[b]Numpad 8 / 2[/b] — Move up and down
[b]Numpad +[/b] — Select
[b]Numpad .[/b] — Go back or close the menu
[b][size=4]Alternative controls[/size][/b]
[b]Page Up[/b] — Open the menu
[b]Up / Down arrows[/b] — Move up and down
[b]= / Enter[/b] — Select
[b]Page Down / Escape[/b] — Go back or close the menu

[u]You can change the main keys under [b]Settings → Controls[/b].[/u]
